title: Odd-moment NEGATIVITY Σηᵢ^{2k+1}=−n^{2k} is an exact all-r left-skew the even-moment-only Bessel/Markov-Krein machinery throws away
evidence: Probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/. (1) probe_C076_moments_exact.py CONFIRMS the odd-moment law exactly via exact integer tuple-counting: for q>n^{2k+1} (char-0), T_{2k+1}=#{tuples in mu_n summing to 0 mod p}=0, so Sum eta_i^{2k+1}=(q*T-n^{2k+1})/n=-n^{2k} (e.g. q=32833 n=8: p_1=-1,p_3=-64,p_5=-4096,p_7=-262144). Law breaks exactly when char-0 fails (T>0). Premise valid. (2) probe_C076_lp.py solves the Chebyshev-Markov max-far-atom LP with even-only rows vs even+odd rows. PRIZE REGIME (beta>=4): q=32833/n=8/beta=5, q=65537/n=16/beta=4, q=8089/n=8/beta=4.33 ALL give B_all/B_even=1.0000 EXACTLY: the odd rows are INACTIVE, the LP max-atom already equals the trivial cap n with even rows alone, and odd rows shrink nothing. The ONLY case where odd rows bind (q=8161/n=32/beta=2.60, ratio 0.87) is OUTSIDE the prize regime (n~sqrt q, the #400 small-beta trap). (3) probe_C076_mechanism.py gives the mechanism: even/odd magnitude ratio p_{2k}/|p_{2k+1}| = E_k/n^{2k} ~ c_k*q/n^{k+1} = c_k*n^{beta-k-1}, which is 11x-500x in-regime, so a balanced atom pair {+n,-n} (invisible to ALL odd moments, contributing only 2n^{2k}<<E_k to even moments) lets the LP saturate the far atom at the trivial maximum +n while matching every even AND odd row simultaneously (explicitly verified feasible with all 7 rows). The far atom at +n is feasible regardless of the odd constraints.
honest_note: The odd-moment LAW ITSELF is real and exactly verified (a genuine char-0 theorem). What is refuted is the connection's CLAIM that re-coupling it into the max-atom extremal LP tightens B. It does not, in the prize regime, for a structural reason: B=max|eta_i| is a MAGNITUDE; the odd moments pin only the SIGNED asymmetry of the bulk, an orthogonal degree of freedom that a balanced far-atom pair leaves untouched, while the even-moment budget exceeds the odd-moment budget by the factor n^{beta-k-1}>>1 for all usable orders k<=beta-1. This is precisely why 'every route symmetrizes first' is correct, not wasteful: symmetrization discards sign info that is irrelevant to B. Scope: tested n=8,16,32 across beta=2.6..5 with exact integer moment data and an exact-arithmetic LP (HiGHS, grids 400-800); not a closed-form proof for all n, but the magnitude-ratio argument n^{beta-k-1} is rigorous and regime-uniform. The open BGK sqrt-cancellation core for thin mu_n is untouched (this connection was a proposed tightening, now shown vacuous in-regime, not a route to it). Recommend logging to DISPROOF_LOG.md.
wall: W-Johnson (BGK/Paley sqrt-cancellation): the connection does not move it; the max-atom B remains bounded only by the even-moment Markov bound min_r E_r^{1/2r}, exactly the existing even-moment route, with the odd moments adding zero tightening.
